title: Callback Number Check
description: Stops expensive and scam callbacks by saying what a number you're about to call back really is (country and line type, from libphonenumber) and flagging a Caribbean +1 876 number posing as a US area code, a one-ring missed call from abroad, premium-rate and shared-cost lines, toll-free numbers that are only free in their own country, unassigned ranges and a 'bank' number missing from the bank's published list, with risky calls needing a second press as the Call button morphs into 'Call anyway' in place.
stops: Called back a premium-rate scam number
